# Omar Sherif - Full Profile & Technical Documentation

## Identity & Professional Summary
- **Full Legal Name**: Omar Sherif
- **Online Handles**: om4rss (GitHub), om4rs (LinkedIn), om4r (Notion Marketplace)
- **Role**: Computer Science Student, Systems & IT Infrastructure Developer, Notion Campus Leader
- **Institution**: Ahram Canadian University (ACU), Faculty of Computer Science
- **Location**: Cairo, Egypt
- **Primary Website**: https://om4r.pages.dev/
- **Alternate Portfolio**: https://om4r.pages.dev/pixel.html
- **Direct Contact**: contact@omardoestech.com

Omar Sherif is a Computer Science undergraduate at Ahram Canadian University with specialized interest in low-level computing, networking protocols, system administration (Windows Active Directory & Fedora Linux), cybersecurity defenses, and digital workspace architecture. He is the official Notion Campus Leader at Ahram Canadian University and the founder/community manager of an 11,000+ member international Notion Discord community.

## Projects Portfolio

### Notion Productivity Workspaces
1. **Minimal Second Brain**
   - URL: https://www.notion.so/marketplace/templates/msb
   - Description: An interconnected Notion architecture based on Tiago Forte's P.A.R.A. methodology, tailored for frictionless daily execution, cross-database relations, and knowledge retention.
2. **Simple Habit Tracker**
   - URL: https://www.notion.com/templates/simplehabits
   - Description: A high-clarity daily tracking system using automated rolling progress metrics and minimalistic aesthetics to build long-term consistency.
3. **Academic OS**
   - URL: https://app.notion.com/templates/academicos
   - Description: A university lifecycle workspace managing courses, credit hours, assignment pipelines, professor contacts, and exam preparation.

### Technical, Hardware & Software Systems
1. **Voice-Controlled ESP32 Robot**
   - GitHub: https://github.com/om4rss/esp32nexusr1
   - Technologies: ESP32, C++, Python, Gemini API, L298N Motor Driver, WebSockets.
   - Description: An intelligent two-wheel-drive robotic platform receiving spoken audio commands, parsing intent through a Python server powered by Google's Gemini multimodal models, and controlling hardware movement with sub-second latency.
2. **Caffeine**
   - GitHub: https://github.com/om4rss/caffeine
   - Technologies: Native C++, Win32 API.
   - Description: A zero-overhead background utility for Windows using SetThreadExecutionState to keep systems awake during intensive computation, render queues, or massive network downloads without altering OS power plans.
